lines.line_text: he will manifest the _truth_ of it unto you,
lines.label: manifest truth

lines.line_text: by the _power of the Holy Ghost_.
lines.label: Holy Ghost power

lines.line_text: And by the _power of the Holy Ghost_
lines.label: Holy Ghost power

lines.line_text: ye may know the _truth_ of all things.
lines.label: know truth

lines.line_text: yea, having had a great _knowledge_ of the goodness and the mysteries of God,
lines.label: knowledge

lines.line_text: therefore I make a _record_ of my proceedings in my days.
lines.label: recording

lines.line_text: Yea, I make a record in the _language_ of my father,
lines.label: father's language

lines.line_text: which consists of the _learning of the Jews_
lines.label: Jews learning

lines.line_text: And I know that the _record_ which I make is true: and I make it with mine own hand:
lines.label: authentic record

lines.line_text: and I make it according to my knowledge.
lines.label: knowledge

lines.line_text: to look forward to his Son for _redemption_.
lines.label: redemption

lines.line_text: And this is the manner after which they were ordained—being _called and prepared_ from the foundation of the world according to the foreknowledge of God,
lines.label: ordained

lines.line_text: on account of their _exceeding faith_ and good works;
lines.label: faith and works

lines.line_text: in the first place being left to _choose good_ or evil;
lines.label: choice

lines.line_text: are _called_ with a holy calling, yea, with that holy calling which was _prepared_ with,
lines.label: ordained

lines.line_text: and according to, a preparatory _redemption_ for such.
lines.label: redemption
